stem:
Nelson is playing a math game. He needs to match two cards that show equivalent shaded fractions.

Nelson's Card
[Image of circle divided into 3 equal parts with 2 parts shaded]

Which of these cards shows a fraction that is equivalent to the fraction on Nelson's card?

options.label: A
options.text: [Image of circle divided into 4 equal parts with 2 parts shaded]

options.label: B
options.text: [Image of circle divided into 6 equal parts with 2 parts shaded]

options.label: C
options.text: [Image of circle divided into 8 equal parts with 4 parts shaded]

options.label: D
options.text: [Image of circle divided into 6 equal parts with 4 parts shaded]

visual_elements: Circle divided into 3 equal parts with 2 parts shaded (Nelson's Card)
Circle divided into 4 equal parts with 2 parts shaded (Option A)
Circle divided into 6 equal parts with 2 parts shaded (Option B)
Circle divided into 8 equal parts with 4 parts shaded (Option C)
Circle divided into 6 equal parts with 4 parts shaded (Option D)
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of equivalent fractions and comparing shaded parts in circles divided into different numbers of segments.
